record.question: A hollow cube of internal edge 22 cm is filled with spherical marbles of diameter 0.5 cm and it is assumed that 1/8 space of the cube remains unfilled. Then the number of marbles that the cube can accommodate is:
record.explanation: Filled fraction=7/8. Cube volume=22³=10648 cm³, occupied marble volume=9317. Each radius-0.25 cm sphere has volume (4/3)π(0.25)³=11/168 cm³ using π=22/7; 9317÷(11/168)=142296. Review note: This is a formal calculation under the source’s explicit 7/8 occupied-volume assumption and π=22/7. Do not present it as physically attainable packing of equal nonoverlapping spheres; that packing fraction is unrealistic. Source-backed independent solution; unofficial, no examiner key asserted.
